_about: Catalog of long-running physical-layer series for the history layer: energy, emissions, resources, land, technology diffusion. Status: pulled = in this directory; planned = retrievable by URL in the workflow; attach = the file must be supplied (login or no stable URL). Every pulled series records its source commit or retrieval date and license. Feeds = the derived feature it supports.

entries.title: Fossil CO2 emissions by country, annual (Global Carbon Budget via Our World in Data)
entries.retrieval: shallow clone of github.com/owid/co2-data (commit in owid_extract.provenance.json)
entries.license: OWID processing CC BY 4.0; Global Carbon Budget CC BY 4.0
entries.caveat: a proxy for fossil energy use; drifts with efficiency and decarbonization, hence the trailing-10-year anomaly

entries.title: Primary energy consumption, fossil production and consumption by fuel, electricity generation (EIA, Energy Institute, Ember via Our World in Data)
entries.coverage: 18 JST countries; consumption 1965-2024, production 1900-2024 for most
entries.license: OWID CC BY 4.0; EIA public domain; Energy Institute Statistical Review free with attribution; Ember CC BY 4.0

entries.title: Crude oil prices since 1861 (Energy Institute Statistical Review; also served by Our World in Data's grapher)
entries.retrieval: ourworldindata.org/grapher/crude-oil-prices (CSV export) or the Statistical Review workbook; not reachable from the sandbox, reachable from the workflow
entries.note: the supply-shock channel; FRED WTISPLC covers 1946- in the meantime

entries.title: Spot crude oil price, WTI, monthly 1946- (FRED)
entries.retrieval: FRED API in the pull workflow

entries.title: Producer price index, all commodities, monthly 1913- (FRED)
entries.retrieval: FRED API in the pull workflow

entries.title: US primary energy consumption by source, annual 1949- (EIA Total Energy API); selected years 1635-1945 (EIA historical table)
entries.retrieval: EIA API (key in the workflow); the 1635-1945 table from eia.gov/energyexplained/us-energy-facts/estimated-consumption-1635-1945.php

entries.title: Energy consumption of European economies 1800-2008 (Kander, Malanima, Warde, Power to the People)
entries.coverage: about eight European countries incl. GBR, DEU, FRA, ITA, ESP, PRT, NLD, SWE
entries.retrieval: dataset distributed with the book / the Energy History project; supply the file
entries.note: replaces the CO2 proxy with measured consumption for the pre-1965 decades

entries.title: Cross-country Historical Adoption of Technology (Comin and Hobijn), 100+ technologies, 150 countries, 1750-2000
entries.coverage: railroads km, electricity, telephones, cars, ships, steel, ... by country
entries.license: NBER research data; free for research
feeds: diffusion_position (lead technology of the era: adoption growth and its second derivative)
entries.note: the diffusion channel: capacity outrunning demand near the inflection (1873, 1893, 2001)

entries.title: Real commodity prices 1850-2015, 40 commodities (Jacks 2013, 'From boom to bust')
entries.retrieval: author's data appendix; supply the file

entries.title: USGS historical statistics for mineral and material commodities (production, prices, since 1900)
entries.retrieval: usgs.gov data series 140; reachable from the workflow

entries.title: Ore-grade decline compilations (Mudd and others: copper, gold)
entries.coverage: selected countries and global, decadal to annual
feeds: marginal_cost_proxy (slow variable for the long cycle)

entries.title: Residential land price series for six countries (No Price Like Home appendix, Figure 16)
entries.coverage: AUS BEL CHE GBR JPN USA
entries.retrieval: already encoded in history/jst/house_prices_documentation.md as figures; digitizing needs the authors' data
entries.note: JST's housing_rent_yd is the live land-scarcity valuation gauge meanwhile
